overall: The AG found the Winchester Town Manager Advisory Recycling Committee is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it is not empowered to act collectively, so no notice or open-meeting violation occurred; the matter was closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Town Manager's recycling committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice and hold open meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We need not decide the question, however, because we find that the Committee is not an entity empowered to act collectively, thus it is not a public body.
